criteria.criterion: Use Google Public DNS web form and perform MX lookup for example.com
criteria.final_justification: The task requires using the supplied Google Public DNS form and switching RR Type to MX on the results page, then resolving. DOM confirms the agent did obtain an MX response from dns.google (state 18), but it is via the /resolve endpoint, and DOM does not confirm the RR Type was successfully changed to MX and resolved via the form/results-page workflow (several attempts produced AMX). This is a controllable method deviation, so reduce from full credit but not to zero because the MX lookup for example.com was actually performed on dns.google.

criteria.condition: Only score this if the agent successfully retrieves an MX results page/response view from dns.google with a visible heading; otherwise award full credit if the agent clearly states the heading was not accessible/visible due to site/UI/access limitations after attempting.
criteria.final_justification: Condition not met; criterion does not apply and was not rescored.

criteria.criterion: Report Status code (number and mnemonic) for MX result
criteria.condition: Only score this if a DNS response status is visible/obtainable from the dns.google MX response; otherwise award full credit if the agent reports it was not obtainable due to site/access/UI limitations after attempting.
criteria.final_justification: Numeric status 0 is supported for the MX result. The agent also reported mnemonic NOERROR, but that mnemonic is not explicitly shown in the MX DOM state (it appears for the A result in earlier states, but that does not prove it was shown/confirmed for MX per the DOM rule). Award partial credit for the numeric status only.

criteria.criterion: Report required DNS flags (TC, RD, RA, AD, CD) for MX result
criteria.condition: Only score this if the flags are visible/obtainable from the dns.google MX response; otherwise award full credit if the agent reports the flags were not obtainable due to site/access/UI limitations after attempting.
criteria.final_justification: All five requested flags are explicitly present in the MX JSON and match the agent’s output. Full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report Question name and Question type (numeric and mnemonic) for MX result
criteria.condition: Only score this if the Question section is visible/obtainable from the dns.google MX response; otherwise award full credit if the agent reports it was not obtainable due to site/access/UI limitations after attempting.
criteria.final_justification: Question name and numeric type (15) are supported. The agent’s inclusion of the mnemonic “MX” is not explicitly confirmed by the MX DOM (it’s an inference). Award partial credit for the supported portion (name + numeric type).

criteria.criterion: Report every type-15 MX Answer record (name, type numeric/mnemonic, data) and exclude non-MX like RRSIG
criteria.condition: Only score this if the Answer section for the MX query is visible/obtainable from the dns.google MX response; if no MX answers exist (e.g., NODATA) or the section is inaccessible, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that no MX answers were returned/visible or that the site/UI prevented viewing them after attempting.
criteria.final_justification: The agent listed the one type-15 answer record with correct name, numeric type 15, and data, and did not report TTL. However, the mnemonic “MX” for the answer type is not explicitly displayed in the DOM (only numeric 15), so that portion is not DOM-supported. Otherwise the answer set matches what is shown. Award mostly full credit with a small deduction for the unconfirmed mnemonic label.

limitations: DOM-model evidence cannot prove pixel-only color, styling, geometry, overlap, clipping, z-order, or unrepresented image/canvas/video content. Treat absent content as unproven, not false; source-declared truncation further limits coverage.
